{{Quote|You have sharp eyes, too, but I won't have a pair of Sharps under my command. Because of your interest in technology, we'll call you Breaker.''"<br />"''Breaker, sir? Sorry, I don't understand. Are you suggesting that I enjoy breaking technology?''"<br />"''Breaker is short for circuit breaker.''"<br />"''Oh.|Clone Captain Lock nicknames 8863|<ref name="SM1" />}}
'''Breaker''', designated '''CT-8863''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in [[Breakout Squad]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Named for his interests in technology, he participated in the [[Mission to Kynachi]], and later joined the survivors of Breakout Squad and their [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] in a mission to the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. After an attack forced them to escape, they found themselves trapped by a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] with a [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|pirate gang]]. They found an ancient [[Infinity Gate]] and managed to escape. They then went on an escort [[Mission to Vaced|mission]] to Vaced, but [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]] [[Langu Sommilor (impostor)|Sommilor]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. The duel with the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] ended in his apparent death, and Breakout Squad traced a dataimager to [[Battle of Bilbringi Depot|liberate]] [[Bilbringi Depot]]. They then discovered the real [[Langu Sommilor|Sommilor]] tied up in his [[Freighter/Legends|freighter's]] hold, and took him back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. There Kungurama confronted his missing master, [[Ring-Sol Ambase]]. Breakout Squad's next mission was to escort [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] freighter to [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], where they defeated the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Dool Pundar]]. At [[Foless/Legends|Foless]] they rescued a group of [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]].

==Biography==
===Breakout Squad's formation===
CT-8863, who would come to be known as Breaker, was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]],<ref name="SM1" /> a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. At the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="DB" /> He wore his [[Color/Legends|black]] hair cropped short.<ref name="Strange Allies" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The battle takes place just prior to the ''Secret Missions'' series.</ref> he and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lock (clone trooper)|Lock]] were assigned to investigate the remains of a [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|battle]] in the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]]. Breaker found a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] from the crashed [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], which revealed it had been constructed by [[KynachTech Industries]]. His interest in technology prompted Lock to grant him the nickname "Breaker." The squad was then assigned to [[Mission to Kynachi|investigate]] [[Kynachi]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ring-Sol Ambase]]. Their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was ambushed by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and destroyed. Along with Ambase's stowaway [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Nuru Kungurama]], Breaker and the survivors took an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to the surface. They eventually liberated the [[Planet/Legends|world]] from the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and earned the moniker of [[Breakout Squad]]. They acquired [[Transport/Legends|transport]] back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with Captain [[Lalo Gunn]] and her ship the ''[[Hasty Harpy]]''.<ref name="SM1" />

===Lost in the black hole===
En route, they received orders from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to go to the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] for a meeting at [[Defense Fleet Command|Defense Station]] [[Ifpe'a]]. There they met [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Sev'eere'nuruodo]] to discuss an alliance, and rescued her from a Techno Union attack. After escaping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], they became trapped near a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] with [[Hethra Mcgrrrr/Legends|Hethra Mcgrrrr's]] [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|pirate gang]]. Kungurama and Breakout Squad managed to locate an ancient [[Infinity Gate]] with a pair of [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Archaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologists]]. The Aristocra returned home while Breakout Squad continued back to Coruscant.<ref name="SM2">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]''</ref>

===Chase on Vaced===
{{Quote|Something just occurred to me. When we return to Coruscant, I doubt the Council will encourage me to continue serving with Breakout Squad. I'm sure they'll assign you to a more experienced leader. I just want you all to know I've learned a great deal from you, and...and I'll miss you all very much.|Nuru Kungurama to Breakout Squad on Bilbringi Depot|<ref name="SM3">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''</ref>}}
When shipping back to Coruscant, Breakout Squad was contacted by Chancellor Palpatine again and asked to [[Mission to Vaced|divert]] to [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]] to meet Kynachi's [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]] [[Langu Sommilor]] and act as his escort. The Commissioner was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] just after his arrival. Chatterbox and Breakout Squad pursued the sniper. The clones got onboard Gunn's ship while Kungurama took a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bike. The sniper, a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] managed to reach his [[Hudu Shiv's Pursuer-class enforcement ship|transport]] and engaged the ''Hasty Harpy,'' causing both ships to crash and leading to the apparent [[Death/Legends|death]] of the sniper. After Breakout Squad and Gunn parted, Kungurama found an imagecaster which led Breakout Squad to take Sommilor's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to [[Bilbringi Depot]], where they [[Battle of Bilbringi Depot|clashed]] with Umbrag again, recapturing the depot.<ref name="SM3" />

===Confrontation on Coruscant===
{{Quote|I began my life in a vat in Kamino ten years ago, which makes me younger than you, sir. And I'm just a soldier without special powers, and I'll never be as wise as a Jedi. But if there's one thing I can tell you, it's that everything doesn't always go according to plan. You have to be ready to improvise. And while you may feel uncertain about many things, Commander, you can trust that the boys and I would gladly follow you anywhere.|Breaker to Kungurama on the voyage to Coruscant|<ref name="SM4">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''</ref>}}
Breakout Squad finished investigating the Depot, and discovered that the Sommilor who had been killed on Vaced was an [[Langu Sommilor (impostor)|impostor]]; the real Sommilor was freed from his captivity in the freighter's hold. Clone [[Medic/Legends|medics]] arrived and stabilized the wounded Chatterbox, with the rest of Breakout Squad donating [[Blood/Legends|blood]], excepting [[Sharp (clone trooper)|Sharp]]. The squad then returned to Coruscant with Sommilor. During the trip in hyperspace, Umbrag managed to grab Kungurama, but was shot in the attempt. Kungurama had a dream about a future duel; when he woke up, he shared his concerns with Breaker, who reassured him. On Coruscant, Jedi Master [[Harro Kelpura]] ordered their freighter to change course from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to his lab in [[Dacho District]], which had been broken into. The ship was then damaged by an impact with a [[Sleight of Hand|dropship]] belonging to a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. The ship crashed but was able to take off and escape, and Kungurama, with Breaker's support, confronted his missing master. Breakout Squad was then assigned to investigate the disappearances of the [[Spice Siren/Legends|''Spice Siren'']].<ref name="SM4" />

===Pirates and younglings===
{{Quote|Good to have you back with us, Commander.|Breaker to Kungurama at the start of their mission|<ref name="Strange Allies" />}}
Breakout Squad's next mission was to escort [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] freighter to [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. When they arrived at the rendezvous on [[Affa/Legends|Affa]], they discovered the remains of a massacre, but they continued their mission to Fondor, where they [[Skirmish at the Fondor Shipyards|defeated]] the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Dool Pundar]]. Once there, their ally [[Gizman|Gizz]] befriended a blind [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], [[Kuvuta Pindi]]. Kungurama agreed to help her escort orphaned [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] to [[Foless/Legends|Foless]]. Once there, they realized Pindi was trying to steal the orphans, and gave chase. They captured Pundar and freed the younglings, but Pindi was killed.<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Personality and traits==
Breaker was skilled with machinery, and was able to recognize the origins of computer parts.<ref name="SM1" /> He knew that plans did not always work out and they had to be ready to be improvise. He and the rest of Breakout Squad were loyal to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and to his commander, Nuru Kungurama.<ref name="SM4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Breaker appeared in [[Ryder Windham]]'s young readers series, ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]''. He and Breakout Squad was first pictured in the comic [[Opress Unleashed|''The Clone Wars: Opress Unleashed'']], a comic released in [[2011]] as part of [[Free Comic Book Day]] and later included in the comic ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]''.
